metadata.malware_name: INV-2026-083 AD credential-access rig (unnamed Linux HTTPS agent and OneDrive side-load beacon)
metadata.family: Unclassified implants; no public family match in our bounded searches (family novelty NOT CHECKED)
metadata.notes: Operator-side indicators only. No victim address, host name, realm, account, credential or hash is in this feed. Cluster members carry the confidence stated in each entry's context, robonode.shop is MODERATE to the C2 zone, and the other candidate-only infrastructure and the excluded names are not listed. Network values are not defanged (machine-readable).

sha256.type: ELF64 x86-64 static, stripped (Linux HTTPS agent)
PE64 DLL (side-load loader, embedded OneDrive beacon)
AES-256-CBC blob, key and IV stored in the file
ELF64 Go build of public chisel tunnel tool
sha256.false_positive_risk: HIGH: stock public build known to VirusTotal since 2024-10-10, 104 submissions; ties the operator to nothing
sha256.notes: Delivered to an agency-egress host on 2026-10-29 (HTTP 200). Use as a file-presence indicator on the delivery path, not as attribution.

ipv4.purpose: Operator host: open directory, agent.bin and chisel delivery, chisel server, NTLM and HTTP capture servers
ipv4.false_positive_risk: MEDIUM: rented M247/Edis address with at least four earlier occupants since 2023; current tenure starts 2026-10-10 (upper bound). Block with a time window.
ipv4.context: Hosting identity DEFINITE (VirusTotal, RIPEstat, RDAP agree); operator control of the address for the campaign window HIGH.

ipv4.purpose: Serves mail.customerlop.top (zone MX and SPF name it)
ipv4.false_positive_risk: HIGH: BlueVPS shared address with several earlier unrelated tenants
ipv4.context: Name pointer HIGH (zone owner's own record, continuous 2026-09-22 to 2026-11-11); operator control of the host MODERATE.

ipv4.false_positive_risk: HIGH: BlueVPS shared address; the SoftEther name predates the zone by six weeks
ipv4.context: Name pointer HIGH; 'a VPN the operator uses' rests on one pointer, MODERATE and no higher (15.9).

ipv4.purpose: Korean VPS: SOCKS5 greeting to the operator's port 80 at start-up; Python listeners, NTLM 401 listeners, page titled SSRFOK
ipv4.false_positive_risk: MEDIUM: rented MOACK address, earlier tenant 2024
ipv4.context: HIGH that it is an attacker-run rig (Hunt.io tag ARTEX, three AttackCapture open-directory entries); MODERATE that it is the same operator as 151.236.22.111. Last Hunt.io record 2026-11-01; whether it is still up is NOT CHECKED.

domains.purpose: agent.bin C2 host and TLS SNI, port 443
domains.false_positive_risk: LOW: the implant's configured C2 zone (who registered it NOT CHECKED) behind Cloudflare; do not block the Cloudflare front addresses
domains.context: Plaintext config slot in agent.bin (VA 0x10a9ac0). Registered 2026-05-22 at Gname (three sources agree). Whether it is live or resolves to a working server is NOT CHECKED (no packet sent).
Zone of the baked-in C2 host; Cloudflare name servers, wildcard certificates from the registration day.

domains.purpose: Unproxied mail name in the C2 zone
Unproxied name in the C2 zone
domains.context: Points to 45.143.167.122; VirusTotal first resolution 2026-10-26, Iris 2026-10-29.

domains.purpose: Zone of a Cloudflare Origin certificate (*.robonode.shop) served from 45.143.167.96, the address mail.customerlop.top resolves to; member of a three-zone family on one BlueVPS mail host
domains.false_positive_risk: MEDIUM: single-source certificate subject (VirusTotal; urlscan corroborates only the timing, a 15-year certificate valid from 2026-10-28); the shared or re-let host alternative on the BlueVPS address is not excluded
domains.context: Link to the C2 zone MODERATE: the Cloudflare Origin certificate for *.robonode.shop on the C2 zone's mail host is a non-commodity leg; the name-server pair, registrar and registrant placeholder carry no weight. Registered 2026-10-14 at Gname. The other two zones of the family and 193.104.75.44 stay out of this feed (LOW to the C2 zone).

mutex_names.context: msedge.dll embedded beacon creates it at start and exits on ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS (0xB7); read in shellcode, not observed running

behavioral_indicators.pattern: Linux process whose /proc/<pid>/cmdline is the single argument '/lib/systemd/systemd --user' (one string containing a space), parent PID 1 or not user@<uid>.service, exe not /usr/lib/systemd/systemd
behavioral_indicators.context: agent.bin argv and PR_SET_NAME spoof (0x1033c50); real systemd --user passes --user as a separate argument
agent.bin re-exec from memfd and plugin ELF execution

behavioral_indicators.pattern: memfd_create('', MFD_CLOEXEC), ftruncate, RWX mmap, execve('/proc/self/fd/N') in one process
sha256 of the 44-byte static string at agent.bin file offset 0xa71d0 = 642fedfa569003ed5427715a9b6a8ea6365f8e10edc935758e0017aeb17aa0d0
behavioral_indicators.context: Cross-sample pivot (XOR key tail). Not a file hash. No other sample compared: NOT CHECKED.

behavioral_indicators.pattern: edge.exe whose OriginalFileName is cookie_exporter.exe loading msedge.dll from a non-Microsoft directory, DLL signed by 'Rockstar Games, Inc.' with SignatureStatus Expired
behavioral_indicators.context: msedge.dll side-load; genuine cookie_exporter.exe under the Edge install does the same LoadLibraryExA call

behavioral_indicators.pattern: cbt.bin (48 to 128 bytes) created by the host process beside config.bin (1488 bytes in this build)
behavioral_indicators.context: msedge.dll beacon time-gate file; direction of the gate comparison not settled

behavioral_indicators.pattern: WinINet agent string exactly 'Mozilla' with POST /<tenant>/oauth2/token?api-version=1.0, grant_type=refresh_token, client_id=d3590ed6-52b3-4102-aeff-aad2292ab01c, then GET/PUT graph.microsoft.com /v1.0/me/drive/root:/cmd/command.txt:/content and output.txt
behavioral_indicators.context: msedge.dll beacon channel; a browserless process doing refresh-token grants is the anomaly; the Microsoft hosts themselves must not be blocked

behavioral_indicators.pattern: OneDrive folder 'cmd' at the drive root holding command.txt, output.txt and cbt.bin
behavioral_indicators.context: operator C2 store; lives in the token owner's tenant, which may not be the victim's

behavioral_indicators.pattern: Entra non-interactive sign-ins, application Microsoft Office, resource Microsoft Graph, about every 15 minutes from one host egress
behavioral_indicators.context: token refresh interval 900000 ms; read in code, not observed

network_signatures.pattern: TCP 443 to www.customerlop.top, one short TLS 1.2 session (mbed TLS 3.6.0 client, no certificate verification) every 54 to 66 seconds; decrypted: POST with headers Host, Content-Type: application/json, Content-Length, Connection: close and no User-Agent
network_signatures.context: agent.bin default Sleep 60 s, Jitter 10 percent. JA3/JA4 NOT COMPUTED.

network_signatures.pattern: POST /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php with body {"key":"<digits>","data":"check"} answered with JSON holding message or status
network_signatures.context: server-side hunt shape for sibling C2 hosts (passive sources first)

hunt_only_never_block.note: Values the implants genuinely use or carry that must not be blocked: Microsoft first-party services, an identifier of unknown ownership, and a certificate whose subject may be a victim.

entries.role: Microsoft identity platform used for the beacon token grant
entries.false_positive_note: Never block; hunt on the path /<tenant>/oauth2/token?api-version=1.0 from a browserless process

entries.role: client_id in the beacon token request
entries.false_positive_note: Believed to be Microsoft's first-party Office public client id (MODERATE, from background knowledge, not verified); every legitimate Office sign-in uses it. Never block.

entries.role: SHA-1 thumbprint of the Authenticode certificate on msedge.dll (subject Rockstar Games, Inc., Entrust OVCS1, valid 2016-03-04 to 2017-03-20)
entries.false_positive_note: TARGET/VICTIM-side subject: legitimate Rockstar binaries signed 2016 to 2017 carry it. Hunt only for binaries signed with it after 2017-03-20 or loaded as an expired signature from a non-game path. Never block.

entries.context: edge.exe: genuine Microsoft cookie_exporter.exe 134.0.3124.51, validly signed. The side-load carrier, not malicious; never block.
Repeated here from behavioral_indicators so a consumer does not treat it as a file hash

explicitly_excluded.note: Classes left out on purpose. Values are not repeated.
classes: Earlier tenants of the operator address and of the BlueVPS addresses (web sites, wildcard-farm zones, mail names)
Two persistent pollers of the capture servers (a cloud-provider address and a carrier address): monitors, not operator infrastructure
Public wildcard-DNS names (nip.io, sslip.io) and vendor hostnames
High-volume or unrelated domains seen on the BlueVPS addresses

Candidate-only: two of the family of three newer zones (LOW to the C2 zone) and their BlueVPS mail host, held back until a second independent link; the third zone, robonode.shop, is listed at MODERATE
Cloudflare front addresses of the C2 zone (shared CDN)
Victim-side values of every kind (agency and second-organisation addresses, hosts, realm, accounts, credentials, hashes)
The Entra tenant id in msedge.dll config.bin: it may belong to a hijacked victim tenant, so it is withheld until Microsoft answers
